.comments{max-width:720px;margin:auto;font:16px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif}.comments-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.comments-toolbar h2{font-size:22px}.comment{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid #ddd}.comment-avatar{width:40px;height:40px;flex:0 0 40px;background:#e5e9ef;text-align:center;line-height:40px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden}.comment-avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.comment-body{min-width:0;flex:1;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.comment-body p{margin:6px 0;white-space:pre-wrap}.comment-body time{font-size:12px;color:#63666b}.comment-body button{background:none;border:0;color:#2767a5;padding:4px 10px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.comment-replies{margin-left:24px}.comments form{display:grid;gap:10px}.comments textarea{min-height:90px;resize:vertical}.comments input,.comments textarea{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}.comments [hidden]{display:none}.fb-comments .comment-body strong{color:#385898}.fb-comments form button[type=submit]{background:#4267b2;color:white}.comments output{font-size:14px}
.comments .comment{margin:0;border-bottom:0}.comments output:empty{display:none}

files.code: *{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:#fff;color:#24272b;font:16px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:0}main{max-width:840px;padding:32px 24px;margin:auto;min-height:0}h1,h2,h3{line-height:1.25}h2{font-size:24px}:where(button,input,select,textarea){font:inherit}:where(button,.cta){cursor:pointer;background:#ffce32;color:#17191c;border:0;border-radius:4px;padding:12px 20px;font-weight:700}button:disabled{opacity:.6}:where(input,select,textarea){border:1px solid #c9ced3;border-radius:4px;max-width:100%;padding:12px;background:#fff;color:#24272b}label{display:grid;gap:6px;text-align:left}form.order-form{width:min(100%,360px);margin:24px auto;display:grid;gap:14px}form.order-form h2{margin:0 0 8px}form.order-form input{width:100%}output,#event-log{display:block;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;background:#f0f5f3;color:#20543e;padding:12px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:18px;min-height:48px;font:14px/1.5 monospace}img{max-width:100%}a{color:#1a5d99}a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1677c2;outline-offset:3px}[hidden]{display:none!important}.sample{width:100%;max-width:480px;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;display:block;margin:auto}.center{text-align:center}.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.large{font-size:48px;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.muted{color:#69737c}.panel{padding:24px;border:1px solid #dce0e4;border-radius:6px}.two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}.notice{padding:20px;background:#f1f6f4;border-left:4px solid #20836b}.demo-toast{position:fixed;left:20px;bottom:20px;max-width:calc(100% - 40px);padding:18px;background:white;box-shadow:0 3px 20px #0002;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:6px}dialog{max-width:calc(100% - 32px);border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:6px}dialog::backdrop{background:#0008}.content{padding:0}.door__title{font-size:24px!important}.door__container{max-width:100%}.order-form input[type=submit]{background:#ffce32}.weight-result{padding:24px;background:#e6f1f5;color:#244859}.weight-result .line1{font-size:24px}.weight-result .line2{font-size:18px}.sticky-order{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;padding:12px;background:#20252c;text-align:center}.sticky-order a{display:inline-block;background:#ffce32;color:#17191c;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:4px;text-decoration:none}.custom-social-proof{max-width:calc(100vw - 24px)!important}.custom-notification{max-width:100%!important}#visitors-panel{max-width:100%;font-size:13px}.comment img{max-width:60px}.comment{margin:18px 0;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}iframe{max-width:100%}@media(max-width:560px){main{padding:24px 14px}.two-col{grid-template-columns:1fr}.large{font-size:38px}h2{font-size:21px}.door__title{font-size:20px!important}}
